theme_archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark Mode Variant). Chosen to make the creative media (videos, book covers) pop against a deep, structural, and distraction-free interface like Linear or Arc Browser.

fonts.heading: Outfit, sans-serif (Geometric, premium, clean)
fonts.body: Manrope, sans-serif (Highly legible at small sizes, structural)

scale.label: text-xs font-body uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-tertiary font-semibold

radii_and_shadows.border_treatment: 1px solid border-subtle everywhere. No heavy shadows, rely on 1px borders to separate layers.

iconography.size: w-4 h-4 for inline, w-5 h-5 for sidebar, w-8 h-8 for empty states

motion.duration: 0.3s for layout shifts, 0.15s for hover states

sidebar_desktop.behavior: Fixed left, border-r border-[#262626], h-screen flex flex-col justify-between
sidebar_desktop.top_section: Logo/Brand (h-14 flex items-center px-4). Main links: Projetos (Home), Personagens, Agentes, Configs. Use layout ID for active state indicator (Framer Motion).
sidebar_desktop.bottom_section: User Profile Dropdown (Avatar + Name) + Credits Counter (minimal text-xs text-secondary bar).
sidebar_desktop.deep_context_behavior: When entering a Project Wizard, the main sidebar HIDES completely to maximize workspace. Replaced by a Top Breadcrumb Nav.

mobile_strategy.implementation: Shadcn Sheet (Left) triggered by a Hamburger menu in a sticky top mobile header. Ensures consistent navigation hierarchy across devices.

projetos_home.layout: Unified single page replacing Dashboard + StudioPage.
projetos_home.header_stats: Inline compact row. 'Projetos (124)' | 'Créditos: 9987/10K' | Search Input (Shadcn Input with Search icon, max-w-sm).
projetos_home.filters: Pill-based Segmented Control (Todos, Vídeos, Livros, Híbridos). Active state: bg-white/10 text-white. Inactive: text-tertiary hover:text-secondary.
projetos_home.grid: Bento-inspired or clean CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6).
projetos_home.card_design: Cardless aesthetic or subtle 1px border. Aspect-video thumbnail (rounded-lg overflow-hidden) + Title + 1 status line (e.g., 'Modo Híbrido • Há 2h'). Overflow menu (...).
projetos_home.novo_projeto_cta: Do not hide as a card. Large prominent button in the top right of the page header. 'Novo Projeto' (action_primary_bg).

project_wizard_chrome.wrapper: Full screen, no sidebar. Top header (h-14 border-b border-[#262626] flex items-center justify-between px-6).
project_wizard_chrome.top_header_left: Breadcrumb: 'Projetos / [Project Name]'. Back button returns to /projetos.
project_wizard_chrome.stepper: Horizontal, center of top header. Minimalist: Step numbers (1, 2, 3) fading out for future steps. Active step is solid white. Use lucide-react 'Check' for completed.
project_wizard_chrome.action_bar: Floating Glassmorphic Pill at the bottom center of the screen (fixed bottom-8). Contains 'Voltar' (secondary) + 'Próximo Passo' (primary).
project_wizard_chrome.sticky_progress: If auto-running, replace action bar with a glowing progress pill (border-amber-500/50 + pulse animation).

directed_studio.steps: 1. Script -> 2. Characters -> 3. Storyboard -> 4. Production -> 5. Review -> 6. Music -> 7. Export
directed_studio.hybrid_banner: Subtle top banner (under main header) for output_mode='both': bg-amber-500/10 border-b border-amber-500/20 text-amber-500 text-sm px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2.
directed_studio.storyboard_grid: Horizontal scrolling or dense masonry of Scene Cards. Each card: Text area for prompt + image placeholder/result + settings cog.

book_studio.steps: 1. Briefing -> 2. Outline -> 3. Arte -> 4. Revisão -> 5. Ilustrações -> 6. Capa -> 7. PDF
book_studio.render_step_layout: Split view or full width. Centerpiece: Large inline PDF viewer (h-[75vh] w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto rounded-xl border border-[#262626] overflow-hidden shadow-floating).
book_studio.metadata_strip: Compact strip below/above PDF. Flex row, gap-4, text-xs. e.g., '24 Páginas | 4.2MB | Preflight: OK (Green Dot)'.
book_studio.actions: Primary 'Baixar PDF' + Secondary 'Mais (Dropdown)' right-aligned in the metadata strip.

states_and_interactions.empty_states: Minimalist. Center aligned. Lucide icon (w-12 h-12 text-[#262626]) + h3 title + body text. No massive illustrations.
states_and_interactions.loading_skeletons: Pulse animation on rounded-lg rectangles. Bg color: bg-[#171717]. Match exact dimensions of final content (e.g., aspect-video for thumbnails).
states_and_interactions.pdf_loading: Real progress bar (already implemented). Style: h-1 w-full bg-[#171717] -> inner div bg-white transition-all.
states_and_interactions.toasts: Sonner styling overrides. Dark mode native. border border-[#262626] bg-[#0A0A0A] text-sm. No emojis, use Lucide icons (CheckCircle2 for success, AlertCircle for error).

technical_constraints_and_rules.file_extensions: All files are .js (React + Vite). DO NOT use .tsx or TypeScript syntax. Use JSDoc comments if type hinting is necessary.
technical_constraints_and_rules.data_testids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards) MUST preserve or include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='new-project-btn').
technical_constraints_and_rules.components: Use existing Shadcn UI components from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/. Do not install new libraries. Customize their Tailwind classes to match this JSON's design language.
technical_constraints_and_rules.icons: Strictly lucide-react. NO emojis anywhere in the UI.
technical_constraints_and_rules.framer_motion: Use layoutId for shared element transitions (like the active state background in the sidebar or tabs). Use simple opacity/y-axis enter animations (initial={{opacity:0, y:10}} animate={{opacity:1, y:0}}).
